'''Premiere Unlimited''' is the white-border reprint of [[Premiere Limited]], with the same 324-card pool.<ref name="lslist">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611184117/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/index.html Premiere Light Side card list] at Decipher.com (archive, 11 June 2002)</ref><ref name="cardlists">[https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008)</ref><ref name="allcards">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007)</ref> Unlimited starter decks and expansion packs followed the limited print run in February 1996.<ref name="collection">[https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions] at Decipher.com (archive, 4 May 1999)</ref>
